stories.title: Senedd Members support calls for better paternity leave in UK-wide parent strike
stories.summary: Parents and politicians joined together on the steps of the Senedd on Thursday calling for better paternity leave and support for new parents. In a campaign organised by Anna Whitehouse (Mother Pukka) and The Dad Shift, similar strikes took place in 13 locations across the UK including in Edinburgh, London, and Belfast on Thursday, August

stories.title: Welsh Government figures show rising proportion of north Wales residents using NHS dentists in England
stories.summary: Nearly one in eleven adults in north Wales who saw an NHS dentist in the two years to March 2026 was treated in England. stories.title: Labour cabinet stands down at neighbouring Denbighshire council, blaming Plaid Cymru
stories.summary: The Labour leader of Denbighshire County Council and his Labour cabinet members have resigned with immediate effect, a week after Plaid Cymru walked out of the coalition that had run the authority for four years. stories.title: Delays on A55 and M56 eastbound as bank holiday getaway begins
stories.summary: Road closures are in place between Daresbury and Walton Golf Club in Cheshire until Sunday for the Creamfields festival. stories.title: Police warn riders over missing number plates after north Flintshire seizure
stories.summary: A scooter has been seized by North Wales Police officers covering north Flintshire, who used the case to warn riders about hiding or removing registration plates.
